name: Amount input
purpose: Currency amount entry — the entry twin of Amount-display. Boxed Input-fields chrome with a currency prefix; numerals are tabular figure composites; the value normalises to grouped thousands + two decimals on blur. Banking-critical (itinerary row 17, P1); built Phase-2 wave 1.

props.name: size
props.$note: standard = .t-cm-figure-5 (16); display = .t-cm-figure-4 (32) — the payment-journey hero entry.

props.name: currency
props.$note: Code before the value, no space (copy-025); symbol (£) closed up. Prefix is aria-hidden — the accessible name carries the currency.

props.name: min
props.$note: Validation floor; zero and negatives rejected on entry (a debit renders with the typographic minus −, display only).

variants.name: standard
variants.use: In-form amount field (GBP prefix + tabular figures).

variants.name: display
variants.use: Prominent single-question entry (You send £—) in payment journeys.

behaviour.typing: Digits, comma, dot accepted while typing; everything else stripped on input.
behaviour.blur: Value normalises: en-GB grouping + exactly two decimals; group gains is-completed (value weight 500).
behaviour.keypad: inputmode=decimal brings the numeric keypad on touch.

accessibility.label: Real <label for> (or aria-label naming the currency when the visible label is elsewhere); help + messages joined via aria-describedby.
accessibility.errors: aria-invalid on the input; message aria-live=polite, text stays ink, roundel carries the colour (1.4.1).
accessibility.figures: Tabular numerals keep amounts column-aligned for low-vision magnification users.

antiPatterns: type=number (spinners + exponent entry + silent clamping — use text + inputmode=decimal).
Hyphen for negative amounts (typographic minus − only, and only in display of debits — entry rejects negatives).
Currency symbol AFTER the value, or a space between code and value (copy-025).
Proportional numerals for money (figures must be tabular).
Red error message text (message stays ink).

tokenValidation.result: PASS — new build, no deprecated tokens: live form/* chrome, R-D20 error set, control radius role, figure composites for all numerals.

provenance.$note: Itinerary row 17 (P1), Phase-2 wave 1 worker A. Chrome authority = gated Input-fields (its featured example is this pattern); money-format authority = gated Amount-display (copy-025, minus, tabular figures). No dedicated Figma node bound yet.
